# How much Child Benefit does the £60,000 charge take back?

> Free UK High Income Child Benefit Charge calculator: enter your income, pension and Gift Aid to see the clawback, how much pension avoids it, and whether to opt out of payments. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
